lookback_summary: Well, it was a mixed bag for the model this weekend, but it definitely had some moments of brilliance! It nailed the calls for Aston Villa vs Nott'm Forest and Crystal Palace vs Ipswich Town, both predicting Not Home wins and seeing the away teams come out on top. However, had to eat humble pie on the Chelsea vs Hull City match where it tipped the banker for a home win, only to see it end in a draw. Liverpool’s draw against Fulham was another head-scratcher, as the model expected a home win there too. Overall, it got more right than wrong, but it’s clear there were some unexpected twists in the results!
